sources.observed_relation: The math supplement needs to measure whether changing independent capability changes delegation needs. The previous runner could revise a candidate while appearing to COMMIT, and forced search and deployed policy did not share the same revision semantics. That makes the key same-state attribution unreliable. This change introduces protocol v2 for the math supplement: - Routing emits exactly COMMIT or one unused subagent call. COMMIT submits the stored candidate unchanged. Forced branches and deployed policy use the same revision function, prompts and sequence seeds; the environment supplies the verifier's actual candidate. - Train call decisions, successful terminal revisions, literal COMMIT and complete independent solutions. Preserve inference prompt tokens when Qwen3.5 BPE merges whitespace at the response boundary. - Use two-round `dynamic_sft` versus refreshed random-success `success_sft`, with optional initial-data `static_sft`. Match optimizer steps and accumulation; report actual tokens without claiming equal FLOPs. Disable the incompatible legacy GRPO entry point. - Add fixed-initial-cohort internalization, aligned before/after calls on learned questions, remaining-rescue
